name: com.rusleo.utils
description: A collection of runtime and editor utilities for Unity 2022.3+. Includes a flexible logging system with live Editor viewer, HUD overlay (FPS/Memory/CPU, no Canvas required), spline math with arc-length parameterization, advanced UI components (long-press, double-click, drag), inspector attributes ([InspectorButton], [Required], [EnableIf]), hotkeys manager with rebind UI, gradient editor, and built-in icon browser.

samples.description: Пример использования утилит в игровом окружении.
